content: I'm hoping he'll come down from 1400, but I'm willing to increase my offer a little if needed, though I'll wait for now.

Dmitri is willing to negotiate down from 1400; I can push a bit more but need to be mindful of his threshold and my deadline.
I now believe Dmitri is willing to negotiate more than I thought, but I still want to close quickly.
